description: VC-BLD-30: linear radius law 1 -> 3 on the top edge of a 20x10x5 block; normal-section volume with the recorded OCCT construction band
formula: V = 1000 - (1 - pi/4) 20 (13/3) = 981.401174161 (section construction; rolling-ball envelope 981.462234); OCCT builds 981.0475 (3.6e-4 relative below the section value), hence the 5e-4 band; planar face areas 160 / 60 are exact
